---
title: "Repeated measures corr (ST13)"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
---

Supplementary Table 13 is the output of the [repeated measures correlation analysis](helper-rmcorr.qmd), filtering self-correlations and any p values > 0.01.

```{r}
library(here)
here::i_am('st13.qmd')
load("out/rmcorr_full.Rdata")

corr <- corr |> dplyr::arrange(padj_v2) |> 
  dplyr::filter(padj_v2 < 0.05)
writexl::write_xlsx(corr, path = here("out/Supplementary-Table-S13.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
DT::datatable(corr)

```

```{r}
connections <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  corr |> dplyr::select(assay_lab = assay_lab1, label = label1),
  corr |> dplyr::select(assay_lab = assay_lab2, label = label2)
) |>
  dplyr::count(assay_lab, label, name = "n_connections") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_connections))

```
